name: Barrio Historico
tagline: Cobblestone UNESCO old town by river
description: The 17th-century Portuguese quarter is Colonia's heart, a UNESCO World Heritage area of cobbled streets, the lighthouse, and the Rio de la Plata waterfront. Cafes, museums, and guesthouses cluster within an easy walk of everything.
bestFor: Short-stay travellers who want atmosphere, walkability and riverside cafes

name: Centro
description: The modern commercial centre around Avenida General Flores holds banks, supermarkets, pharmacies and the bus terminal. It is more functional than pretty but has the best access to services and is close to the ferry port from Buenos Aires.
bestFor: Longer stays wanting amenities, groceries and transport connections nearby

name: Real de San Carlos
tagline: Quiet riverside area north of town
description: A quieter residential zone a few kilometres north, known for its early-1900s ruins including an old bullring and hotel, plus long river beaches. It suits those wanting calm and space, though you need a bike or bus to reach the centre.
bestFor: Slow travellers wanting quiet, beaches and lower rents outside the centre

name: Rambla Costanera
description: The waterfront promenade lining the Rio de la Plata offers small beaches, parks and a string of restaurants. Staying along the rambla gives easy walking access to both the Old Town and the water, with steady breezes and open views.
bestFor: Visitors who value water views, running paths and sunset walks
